en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large stone-and-plaster building with strong early‑20th‑century modernist / National Romantic features. The façade has tall vertical windows, a large gable with an emblem or coat of arms, and massive stone walls. Attached to the side is a distinctive rounded tower-like volume with a conical roof. Behind, higher roof structures with rounded caps are visible. In front, a street scene shows a tram on the left, several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, a horse-drawn cart, and an early automobile on the right, indicating an urban European setting of that era. The postcard border is plain and aged, with no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
